name: g57_mb_paralysed_bouncer
purpose: Magic Bounce (step G57): Nuzzle (not reflectable, so it lands) by Hatterene paralyses Espeon; then Ceruledge's Taunt aimed at Espeon is bounced. The holder's paralysis does not stop the bounce (the bounced move skips BeforeMove). Espeon's Yawn aimed at Hatterene (also a Magic Bounce holder) is bounced back to Espeon.
